Container.Name: FalconBeat
Container.Overview: Synced light-show audio for Falcon Player (FPP). Visitors open a webpage on their devices and hear the show audio in sync with the lights. Requires the fpp-plugin-FalconBeat plugin on your FPP controller, and a Cloudflare Tunnel (or equivalent HTTPS ingress) pointed at the WebUI port for public access.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The only port — point cloudflared here AND the FPP plugin's FalconBeat URL. Carries the listener page, /media audio, /ws, and the token-gated ingest/upload routes

Config.Name: Media Directory
Config.Description: Show audio pushed by the FPP plugin lands here; Caddy serves it at /media/*

Config.Name: FalconBeat Token
Config.Description: The one shared secret — plugin admin auth, ingest Bearer, and the /upload/complete gate. Long random string. Paste the same value into the plugin's Token field
